title: Refund policy
text: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. A receipt or order number is required. Refunds return to the original payment method.

title: Delivery policy
text: Standard delivery takes three to five business days. Express delivery takes one business day. Delivery delays do not automatically change refund eligibility.

title: Payroll policy
text: Payroll corrections must be submitted to HR. The payroll review window is seven days after the payslip is issued.

title: Other tenant refunds
text: This tenant permits refunds within 90 days.
